summary: STEP ASIDE — compound shock session. Two concurrent structural catalysts arrived overnight: (1) The Information confirmed China has begun mass production of domestic DUV lithography machines (~5 in 2026, ~20 in 2027), triggering ASML −8.4% Amsterdam, KOSPI circuit breakers at −10.84%, SK Hynix −14.7%, Samsung −13.4%; (2) WSJ/Bloomberg confirmed NVDA circular financing structure ($250B OpenAI data center backstop + $350B chip purchase financing), which repriced AI capex ROI sector-wide a day earlier. The Dow/Nasdaq divergence widened to its largest in 3+ months: Dow futures +0.3% vs NQ futures −0.9%, driven by chip-rout rotation into defensives. FOMC Day 1 today; decision July 29 2pm ET with September hike probability at ~75% per futures. Oil extended declines — Brent $85.08 at the regime-clearance trigger level, WTI $80.11 (−3%). Four positions closed: two stopped (NVDA −7.3%, AMD −10.9%, both casualties of the AI chip rout and circular financing repricing) and two target hits (GM +8.3% on Jefferies upgrade + FY guidance raise, XLF +6.3% at 52-week high). Three new opportunities initiated: Short ASML on China DUV structural multiple compression (medium conviction, 6–8 weeks), Long DIA on Dow/Nasdaq divergence defensive rotation (low conviction, 2–3 weeks), Short EWY on Korea circuit-breaker double-catalyst structural damage (medium conviction, 4–6 weeks).

closed_today.note: Stop hit at $198 — NVDA closed $196.51 on July 27 on WSJ/Bloomberg circular financing confirmation. Three concurrent short arguments (circular financing, China DUV ASML spillover, KOSPI rout) confirmed. Full re-assessment after Aug 26 Q2 FY27 earnings.
